CONFIDENTIAL
  PUBLIC




                 ERCOT Monthly
               Operational Overview
                    (October 2026)


                     ERCOT Public
                   November 17, 2026
 PUBLIC    Highlights, Records and Notifications

     • ERCOT set a new record of 81,487 MW* for the month of October on 10/13/2026; this is 5,583
       MW more than the October 2025 demand of 75,904 MW on 10/02/2025.

     • ERCOT issued 5 Advisories:
           •   ERCOT issued an Advisory on 10/09/2026: ERCOT has postponed the deadline for the posting of the DAM solution for
               Operating Day 10/10/2026 due to long run time.
           •   ERCOT issued an Advisory on 10/10/2026: Advisory issued for a geomagnetic disturbance of K-7 until October 10, 2026, 1900.
           •   ERCOT issued an Advisory on 10/15/2026: ERCOT has issued an advisory due to TSAT not solving in the last 30 minutes.
           •   ERCOT issued an Advisory on 10/31/2026: ERCOT has postponed the deadline for the posting of the DAM solution for
               Operating Day 11/01/2026 due to long run time.
           •   ERCOT issued an Advisory on 10/31/2026: DAM is complete, DRUC will begin at 1540.
     •   ERCOT issued 1 DC Tie Curtailment Notice:
           •   On 10/29/2026 ERCOT curtailed DC_L (Laredo VFT) due to an outage.




                                                                                         * Preliminary value from October Demand and Energy 2026 report.

 PUBLIC       Planning Summary

         •   ERCOT is tracking 1,847 active generation interconnection requests totaling 461,414 MW as of
             October 31, 2026. This includes 151,798 MW of solar, 49,781 MW of wind, 160,102 MW of battery,
             and 95,032 MW of gas projects; 169 projects were categorized as inactive, down from 175 in
             September.

         •   ERCOT is currently reviewing proposed transmission improvements with a total estimated cost of
             $22.330 billion as of October 31, 2026.

         •   Transmission Projects endorsed in 2026 total $12.660 billion as of October 31, 2026.

         •   All projects (in engineering, routing, licensing and construction) total approximately $63.5398 billion
             as of October 1, 2026.

         •   Transmission Projects energized in 2026 total approximately $1.383 billion as of October 1, 2026.

         •   Transmission Projects planned to energize during the remainder of 2026 total approximately
             $5.330 billion as of October 1, 2026.

 PUBLIC   Loads Approved to Energize - Observations
         •   Of the 9,456 MW that have received Approval to Energize, ERCOT has observed a non-simultaneous monthly
             peak consumption of 5,115 MW in October 2026, which is a large increase since September 2026.
             – This is calculated as the sum of the maximum value for each individual load per month.
             – This value represents how much approved load ERCOT believes is now operational.

 PUBLIC   ERCOT identified one pricing incident, but it did not meet the criteria to
         correct prices


   Did Not Meet Criteria
   On Operating Day October 08, 2026, ERCOT performed a scheduled site failover and activated
   Emergency Basepoints. ERCOT’s analysis showed an estimated absolute total dollar impact of
   $281.53 for changes to Real-Time prices for energy metered. This impact did not meet the
   significance criteria of $500 and so ERCOT did not correct prices.
